title: compliancetf.consume-receipt/v1
description: The receipt the compliance.tf Evidence API signs when ctfkit gate sign consumes a break-glass override; embedded whole in the verdict's break_glass_receipts and verified offline by the compliance.tf terraform provider. Every value is a string, array or object. The signature member covers the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the document without it, signed by a key of the profile's break_glass.receipt_keys. pkg/verdict.ParseReceipt is the reference reader.

override_digest.description: sha256 over JCS of the whole override, signature included

request_digest.description: B9: sha256 over JCS of {org_id, workspace, environment, plan_digest, content_digest, floor_epoch, override_id, controls (sorted), instance_keys (sorted)}

instance_keys.description: Action keys: instance_key, or delete_key for a destroy half.

value.description: base64url without padding of the ASN.1 DER signature
